# Contributing to Echo Oblivion

← [Back to README](../README.md)

Thanks for your interest. Echo Oblivion is a closed-source project — the backend and frontend are not open for external contribution. However, the **public documentation repository** accepts contributions.

---

## What You Can Contribute

### ✅ Documentation

- Fix typos, broken links, or outdated information in any `.md` file
- Improve explanations in [FEATURES.md](../docs/FEATURES.md), [COMMANDS.md](../docs/COMMANDS.md), [FAQ.md](../docs/FAQ.md), or [PAIRING.md](../docs/PAIRING.md)
- Add a language translation of a documentation file
- Improve the [DEPLOYMENT.md](../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) guide based on your own self-hosting experience
- Document an undocumented edge case or troubleshooting tip

### ✅ Bug Reports

If you've found a bug in the bot (unexpected behavior, a command that crashes, wrong output), open an issue using the [Bug Report template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml).

### ✅ Feature Requests

If you have an idea for a new command or feature, open an issue using the [Feature Request template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml). Not all requests become features, but all are read.

### ✅ Security Vulnerabilities

Do **not** open a public issue for a security vulnerability. Report privately — see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

---

## How to Submit a Documentation Fix

1. Fork this repository
2. Create a branch: `git checkout -b fix/typo-in-commands`
3. Make your change
4. Open a pull request with a clear title and description of what you changed and why

Keep PRs focused — one fix or improvement per PR makes review faster.

---

## Code of Conduct

- Be respectful. This is a community project.
- Don't open issues to ask for support — use [t.me/silentiumXgroup](https://t.me/silentiumXgroup) instead.
- Don't reverse-engineer or attempt to access the bot's backend infrastructure.
- Don't open duplicate issues — search first.
